title: Baghdad Day Qaidi Nu
body:
Baghdad Day Qaidi Nu, Jadon Ujreya Dhiaan Nay, Ro Ro Kay Wida Kita.
<<DIVIDER>>
Payean Kardian Baba Baba. Sun Kamb Gaye Arsh Khudha Dah,
Gal Nalo Jado Shah. Nay Dhiyaan Nu Judah Kitah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbal Dhi Kahani Nu Injh Waqt Nay Dohorya
Lagdah Si Jivay Mur Ke Fair Dour-e-yazid Aya
Babay Day Hathi Hath Qarian Dhiaan Roun Bhoray Taj Kharian
Sajaad Dhi Sunaat Nu Kazim Nay Addah Kita.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zanjeeran Sanay Chayea Mazdooran Nay Maiyaat Nu
Sir Khakh Paye Zahra Takh Putar Dhi Halat Nu
Ajh Fazaal Dah Baba Avay Ah Touk Galay Da Laway
Mazloom Musafir Dah Umaat Nah Haya Kita.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan Day Vich Jis Nay Zindaghi Hai Lagha Chori
Ohdi Laash Musalmanaan Rahwaan Chay Rulla Chori
Kufay Chay Ali Kurlay Baqieay Chu Wain Siayee
Dil Torya Ahmed Dah Zahra Nu Khafa Kita.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kisay Ruldeya Nahi Wekhi Inj Laash Aaseeran Dhi
Bazaraan Wicho Away Chankaar Zanjeera Day
Murjaan Siphahi Ke Haath Nabz Utay Tar Tar Ke
Paakh Mout Dah Ho Gaye Si Phir Kio Nah Rehna Kita.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ainjh Ghafil Mataam Toun Nah Koyi Pursa Daar Howay
Matam Naal Tere Ronda Khara Paakh Beemar Howay.
Us Ujri Parchaonay Jinay Shaam Icho Rondyea Auna Ay
Haar Chaikh Abour Aktar Jumay Baajh Ridah Kita.
